title: Sensor message envelope
description: Envelope of a parsed sensor message published to RabbitMQ. The payload structure depends on sensor_type and is validated against the corresponding payload-*.schema.json.

message_id.description: UUID v4 used for idempotent deduplication.

project_id.description: Project identifier in snake_case. Examples: shangtan, lingzhan.

sensor_id.description: Sensor identifier following the paper's convention (e.g. GXZM-DB03, LZ-01).

timestamp.description: When the sensor took the reading. ISO 8601 in UTC.

received_at.description: When Data Receiving received the raw packet. ISO 8601 in UTC.

sampling_interval_seconds.description: Sampling interval at the moment of the reading. 3600 by default; lower in accelerated conditions.
